proposal.falsifier_or_acceptance_gate: Reject every preregistered mutation and retain represented status with zero production, participant, operational, professional, or authority credit.
proposal.hypothesis: A bounded JWT best-current-practice validation artifact can expose declared obligations while refusing unsupported scientific, operational, identity, or authority promotion.
proposal.novelty_against_880_frozen_proposals: Earlier JWT profiles cover individual token forms, but no frozen profile isolates RFC 8725 algorithm verification, explicit typing, cross-JWT confusion, and mutually exclusive validation rules.
proposal.null_or_failure_condition: The artifact omits a declared JWT best-current-practice validation obligation, accepts a preregistered mutation, erases a negative, or promotes a result beyond its evidence lane.
proposal.rollback_or_recovery: Stop the proposal, retain every failed witness, rewrite no history, and leave external, sibling, participant, production, and authority state unchanged.
proposal.title: Freed ID RFC 8725 JWT BCP algorithm-allowlist, key-algorithm binding, explicit-typing, cross-JWT confusion, issuer, audience, replay, minimization, and nonproduction profile
